description: See whether AI assistants actually recommend your business. Website Auditor puts the questions a real customer would ask to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity, reports which businesses get named in the answers, and adds SEO, security-header, broken-link and performance checks — an overall AI-visibility score (0–100), a per-engine breakdown, competitor comparisons, and ongoing weekly monitoring. The built-in sample report needs no API key and no setup, so you can see exactly what a full report looks like before connecting an account.
